name: Elastic Cloud API
description: This RESTful API enables you to perform most of the operations available in the UI console through API calls. You can create an API key to quickly and easily authenticate, then use the API to create and manage deployments, configure remote clusters, set up traffic filters, manage extensions, and much more. Access the API from its base URL at api.elastic-cloud.com . To manage your serverless projects, use the Elastic Cloud Serverless API.
